payload.title: Restrict the solution parameter to an allow-list of solution names
payload.description:
As the site owner, I want the generate_lead solution parameter limited to real solution names so that GA4 data cannot be polluted by arbitrary query-string values.

Change: in web/static-root/engage-inquiry.js replace the free pattern for solution with an allow-list of Cyclotron, Chatticus, Papyrus, Primus, Auritus, plus any other solutions listed on /ai-solutions/ (confirm the list from that page). Values not on the list are omitted from the event, not sent. Add tests.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Known solution
  Given the engage page is opened with solution=Cyclotron
  When the lead is confirmed with a 202 receipt
  Then generate_lead includes solution=Cyclotron
Scenario: Unknown solution
  Given the engage page is opened with solution=anything-else
  When the lead is confirmed
  Then generate_lead omits the solution parameter
Scenario: List matches the site
  Given the solutions on /ai-solutions/
  When the allow-list is compared with them
  Then every listed solution is allowed and no others are
Tests cover case handling and unknown values.

Dependencies: none.
